_about: Order 14 lane C (16 Nov 2026): which books GOVERN each kind of paper, down to the clause where a book governs only in part. Gate G2 reads this file (`scripts/crs_gates.py --mapping`); a book this file does not list for the paper's kind fails G2 ('book not listed for this kind'), and a book limited to clauses fails outside them. Sources: reference/standard_roles.json (a procedure or study takes process/method and general books; its method books), reference/governing_standards.json (equipment type -> books, the materials books, the books that govern in part), the owner's order 14 (ASME VIII Div 1 for relief valves: UG-150 to UG-156 only; pump numbers from SAES-G-005 and SAES-K-503) and the held book's own title for the company books added per type (SAES-D-001 design criteria for pressure vessels; SAES-L-109 flanges, stud bolts and gaskets; SAES-L-132 materials selection for process equipment). tests/test_o14_c_kind_books.py keeps it a SUPERSET of the app's tables per type (it never lists fewer books than the review selects by type) and keeps every equipment design book out of the procedure and study entries. A kind or type with no entry here: G2 is not run for it. Owner-editable data; an engineer adds books per type.
